questions.question: Plants that do not have well - differentiated body design fall in this group. The plants in this group are commonly called algae. This group is ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Thallophytes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thallophytes**:-

 
 
• **These are a diverse group of organisms that includes both unicellular and multicellular plants. **
 
• They are found in a wide range of habitats, from freshwater and marine environments to terrestrial environments.
 
• Thallophytes do not have true roots, stems, or leaves. Instead, their bodies are typically flattened and leaf-like, and they absorb water and nutrients directly from their environment.
 
• **The group of plants that do not have a well-differentiated body design and are commonly called algae is thallophyta.**
 
• Examples of thallophytes include:
 
 
• **Green algae:** Spirogyra, Ulothrix, Cladophora
 
• **Brown algae**: Fucus, Laminaria, Sargassum
 
• **Red algae**: Porphyra, Gelidium, Gracilaria
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gymnosperms:-

 
 
• These are a group of plants that produce seeds but do not have flowers. 
 
• They include conifers, cycads, ginkgoes, and others.
 
• Gymnosperms have a higher number of species compared to bryophytes and algae.
 
• Gymnosperms are typically slow in terms of reproduction; up to a year may pass between pollination and fertilisation and seed maturation may require 3 years.
 
 
 
• **Bryophytes**:-
 
 
• **These are a group of non-vascular plants that includes mosses, liverworts, and hornworts. **
 
• They are called non-vascular plants because they do not have specialized tissues for transporting water and nutrients, such as xylem and phloem.
 
• Bryophytes are typically small plants that grow in moist, shady environments. They are found all over the world, from the Arctic to the tropics.
 
 
 
• **Pteridophytes**:-
 
 
• **These are vascular plants that reproduce by spores. **
 
• They are also known as ferns and lycophytes.
 
• Pteridophytes were the first vascular plants to colonize the land, and they played a major role in the evolution of plant life.

questions.question: Which among the following waves is not an electromagnetic wave?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cathode Rays.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Cathode Rays:-**

 
 
• **Cathode rays are streams of electrons emitted from the cathode (negatively charged electrode) of a vacuum tube. **
 
• They are produced when a high voltage is applied between the cathode and another electrode, called the anode (positively charged electrode).
 
• The electrons are accelerated by the electric field and travel through the vacuum tube at high speeds.
 
• **It is not an Electronic Magnetic Wave.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ultraviolet (UV) rays:-**

 
 
• **These are a type of electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible light and longer than X-rays. **
 
• UV rays are not visible to the human eye, but they can have a significant impact on our health and the environment.
 
• UV rays are produced by the sun, but they can also be produced by artificial sources, such as tanning beds and germicidal lamps.
 
 
 
• **Infrared (IR) rays:-**
 
 
• **These are a type of electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths longer than visible light and shorter than microwaves. **
 
• IR rays are not visible to the human eye, but we can feel them as heat.
 
• IR rays are produced by all objects with a temperature above absolute zero. The hotter the object, the more IR rays it produces.
 
 
 
• **Gamma rays:**
 
 
• **These are the most energetic type of electromagnetic radiation. **
 
• They have shorter wavelengths and higher energies than X-rays.
 
• Gamma rays are produced by radioactive decay, nuclear reactions, and certain astronomical events.
 
• Gamma rays are highly penetrating and can damage living cells. They are used in a variety of applications, such as cancer treatment, medical imaging, and materials science.

Circular track length = 720 m, speeds = 1.5 m/s and 3.5 m/s

Relative speed concept in circular track.
